name: Anchor Touch
tagline: By touching an unattended object, steady it briefly: a rattling shutter, loose door or unstable stack. The effect holds ordinary objects in place for seconds, giving someone time to secure them.

tiers.4: A light object remains steady for a single breath.
tiers.8: A loose door, shutter, or small stack remains stable for a moment.
tiers.12: A larger everyday object stops shifting for a few seconds.
tiers.16: A sizable but ordinary unstable structure becomes briefly still, allowing someone to secure it by normal means.
tiers.20: Several connected, uncontested parts of a local obstacle can be steadied for a few seconds; lasting repairs still require appropriate work.

echoMemory: Cold iron presses into your palms. In another lifetime, a storm rattled a strange front door while a child wept behind you.

name: Burden's Mercy
tagline: Make a load you can already lift feel lighter while carrying it at an unhurried pace. Normal lifting limits and combat encumbrance still apply.

tiers.4: A small heavy bag or toolkit feels lighter for about a minute.
tiers.8: An ordinary pack feels lighter for several minutes.
tiers.12: A chest or load you can already lift becomes more comfortable to carry over a short distance.
tiers.16: A bulky but portable load remains easier to carry along a longer safe path.
tiers.20: An exceptionally heavy yet still carryable everyday load becomes bearable for part of a short journey.

echoMemory: The weight of a house beam rests on your shoulder. When you look up, the street belongs to a long-vanished harbor town.

name: Stoneprint
tagline: Press a small lasting decorative mark into ordinary inert material with your fingertips. Marks remain ornamental; functional craftwork and structural changes require the relevant methods.

tiers.4: Leave a fingerprint or tiny symbol in stone, wood, or soft metal.
tiers.8: Emboss one clear palm-sized mark or a few rough characters.
tiers.12: Leave a short line of simple, coarsely pressed characters.
tiers.16: Form a distinct, palm-sized relief with a recognizable motif.
tiers.20: Create a small, simple commemorative relief without tools, but never precise craftsmanship or structural alterations.

echoMemory: Your fingers remember a farewell sign pressed into a gray city wall. You no longer know its language, only the grief.

name: Hollow Echo
tagline: Tap a reachable surface to sense broad differences in its resonance. A hollow response suggests where to investigate; finding a concealed seam, trap or mechanism still requires an appropriate Skill.

tiers.4: Hear whether the spot beneath your hand sounds broadly hollow or solid.
tiers.8: Follow changes in that sound across a small reachable surface.
tiers.12: Sense a vague resonance pattern along one connected, ordinary wall or floor section.
tiers.16: Distinguish several broad resonance differences within the same accessible surface.
tiers.20: Feel a clearer local pattern of pressure and hollow space; it can suggest where to search, but precise discovery remains a Skill task.

echoMemory: The vibration becomes another hammer striking another stone. For a heartbeat you stand in a mine abandoned centuries ago.

name: Feather Step
tagline: Cross ordinary ground slowly with unnaturally light footsteps, leaving faint pressure or disturbance. Resolve Stealth, hazards and Movement Powers through their normal rules.

tiers.4: One or two gentle steps disturb dust, leaves, or creaking boards less than expected.
tiers.8: Cross a few paces of an everyday delicate surface carefully and quietly.
tiers.12: Leave only a faint shift in pressure along a short, unhurried passage.
tiers.16: Your slow steps leave unusually light traces on ordinary soft ground.
tiers.20: Cross a small room or courtyard with minimal pressure from careful footsteps; Stealth and hazards still require normal resolution.

echoMemory: The cold grass beneath your feet becomes thin snow upon a bridge. Your feet were far smaller in that life.

name: Catfall
tagline: Recall a practiced landing from a former life: roll, brace and soften a controlled descent. Resolve dangerous heights through the normal falling rules.

tiers.4: Land cleanly from a low wall or ledge.
tiers.8: Turn an ordinary short drop or awkward small jump into a soft roll.
tiers.12: Find a natural controlled landing motion during a planned descent.
tiers.16: Appear almost unnaturally light when landing from a higher but still manageable position.
tiers.20: Land almost silently after an impressive but still realistically survivable descent; lethal falls remain lethal.

echoMemory: You roll across cobblestones. Yet the memory shows red dust, a narrow alley, and a body in which you fell long ago.

name: Dancing Thread
tagline: With a gesture, make loose threads, ribbons or very light fabric follow a graceful movement. The threads remain delicate and cannot restrain or manipulate solid objects.

tiers.4: One loose thread or ribbon end follows your gesture for several seconds.
tiers.8: Two small ribbons follow a slow motion.
tiers.12: Several very light scraps of fabric briefly move together.
tiers.16: A light veil or several loose ribbons trace simple patterns for seconds.
tiers.20: Create a brief graceful choreography of lightweight cloth, with no strength to bind or manipulate solid objects.

echoMemory: The fabric rises, and your fingers recall a stage above water. Applause falls around you in a language you do not speak.

name: Needle Balance
tagline: Keep a small unattended object poised in an improbable balance for a brief moment. The delicate effect supports only the listed objects, not weight, mechanisms or living creatures.

tiers.4: A coin or needle balances on an unlikely edge for seconds.
tiers.8: Two small objects briefly maintain unusual balance.
tiers.12: One delicate small object stands unnaturally still for about a minute.
tiers.16: A handful of tiny light objects briefly hold an intricate arrangement.
tiers.20: Build a fleeting miniature display of impossible balance; it supports no weight and offers no physical resistance.

echoMemory: A coin stands upon its edge. You remember a tightrope over a brightly lit city and the hands of an unfamiliar performer.

name: Living Warmth
tagline: Your palms radiate gentle warmth to hands, clothing or small everyday objects. The effect provides comfort; Health, healing, cold exposure and damage use their own rules.

tiers.4: Warm your fingertips or a small object briefly.
tiers.8: Keep a cup, cloth, or willing hand pleasantly warm for several minutes.
tiers.12: Gently warm a small bundle of fabric or a bowl.
tiers.16: Spread mild comfort through a cloak or bedroll for a little while.
tiers.20: Make a small campsite briefly cozy without protecting against lethal exposure.

echoMemory: Warmth returns to your hands. You recall cradling a sleeping child while heavy snow fell outside a strange window.

name: Seed Whisper
tagline: Coax modest natural growth from an existing healthy bud or viable seed. The effect accelerates a small natural change; sustained growth still needs ordinary conditions.

tiers.4: A ready bud opens a little.
tiers.8: A viable seed shows its first moment of germination.
tiers.12: Several existing buds on a small twig open.
tiers.16: A small potted plant unfolds existing leaves or flowers unusually quickly.
tiers.20: A handful of viable seeds or a small branch show modest new growth; real maturity still requires time and suitable conditions.

echoMemory: A seed cracks open. You recall a garden between white walls and a name called from the far end of its path.

name: Pulse Touch
tagline: With a willing creature’s direct skin contact, feel its pulse, breath and warmth as a subjective impression. Interpreting illness or injury remains a Medicine task.

tiers.4: Sense whether one willing creature's living rhythm feels broadly calm or restless.
tiers.8: Notice subtle shifts in that rhythm.
tiers.12: Experience its rhythm as a brief inner image, still medically indefinite.
tiers.16: Hold that subjective sense of life for several quiet breaths.
tiers.20: With calm consent, briefly distinguish the rhythms of two willing living creatures; diagnose or heal neither.

echoMemory: A heart beats beneath your palm. Another lifetime shows an old patient on a cot and a pulse strangely familiar to you.

name: Preserve
tagline: Slow the ordinary spoilage of a small amount of wholesome food or cut flowers. It preserves their existing condition; purifying contaminants and crafting ingredients require appropriate rules.

tiers.4: Keep one piece of fruit or a flower fresh for several extra hours.
tiers.8: Keep a small meal good overnight, provided it was safe to begin with.
tiers.12: Slow the aging of a small basket of ordinary food for one day.
tiers.16: Keep a small bag of simple perishables fresh for a few additional days.
tiers.20: Preserve a modest box of everyday perishable food for up to a week, without purifying or enhancing it.

echoMemory: The fruit keeps its scent. You remember baskets aboard a fishing boat and the dread of a winter arriving too soon.

name: Mage Hand
tagline: Summon a small spectral hand to move a light unattended object. Fine toolwork, locks, traps and Artifacts still require the appropriate capability.

tiers.4: Move a tiny everyday object within reach.
tiers.8: Carry a light cup, feather, or key a few steps.
tiers.12: Carefully lift and shift one light object from several paces away.
tiers.16: Perform a sequence of simple, careful motions with the spectral hand.
tiers.20: Handle one light, unattended object within a modest room almost like your own hand, but without strength or specialist knowledge.

echoMemory: The key rises into the air. Suddenly you sit at a table of brass instruments, wearing old hands and unfamiliar rings.

name: Message
tagline: Send a brief private mental whisper to a nearby visible or familiar recipient. It carries a short message rather than sustained telepathy or mind reading.

tiers.4: Send one brief sentence to a person in the same room.
tiers.8: Deliver a short message to someone nearby even through ordinary noise.
tiers.12: Receive one brief reply.
tiers.16: Exchange a few quiet thoughts across a large hall or courtyard.
tiers.20: Hold a brief private conversation with one person within a small building area, but not through powerful seals or to an unknown distant target.

echoMemory: The whispered name lingers in your mind. You recall speaking into darkness while unfamiliar bells tolled.

name: Arcane Spark
tagline: Shape harmless sparks, dim floating lights or momentary visible glyphs. These are signs and ambient light, distinct from ignition, damaging light and functional ritual sigils.

tiers.4: Create a fingertip-sized spark or glimmering dot for seconds.
tiers.8: Hold a tiny light or simple suspended sign for a moment.
tiers.12: Arrange several tiny lights into a slowly moving pattern.
tiers.16: Display a short readable line of light-written text for a few minutes.
tiers.20: Create a small gentle scene of lights and glyphs for minutes; they remain decorative and visibly magical.

echoMemory: Letters of light float before you. In another life you studied in a tall tower, reading a script you can no longer decipher.

name: Fleeting Conjuration
tagline: Conjure a fragile, visibly magical ornament that dissolves shortly afterward. Its value and function are purely decorative; useful goods follow ordinary crafting and equipment rules.

tiers.4: A tiny glasslike pebble or decorative mote appears for seconds.
tiers.8: A fingernail-sized ornament lasts a little longer.
tiers.12: A simple palm-sized decoration exists for up to one minute.
tiers.16: Its surface becomes more intricate and it lasts a few minutes.
tiers.20: A detailed yet fragile hand-sized ornamental shape persists for several minutes, clearly unreal and unsuitable for practical use.

echoMemory: A glass bird rests in your palm. You remember gifting one to someone in a different life, but their face has vanished.

name: Still Mind
tagline: Enter an unnatural moment of inner quiet. The effect changes the character’s perception of their own thoughts; Fear, conditions and resistance retain their normal mechanics.

tiers.4: One breath makes it easier to gather yourself before speaking.
tiers.8: Find the start of a calming ritual even during a tense pause.
tiers.12: Let distracting feelings pass for a few quiet moments.
tiers.16: Recover a clear sense of inward composure during a safe break.
tiers.20: Carry this brief inner calm for a few minutes into a difficult conversation, without bypassing emotion or mental mechanics.

echoMemory: You close your eyes. Salt wind touches your face, and you sit on a cliff you have never visited in this lifetime.

name: Sense Taint
tagline: While calmly observing, feel a vague spiritual disturbance from a clearly present tainted place or object. Read Resonance determines the source and nature of such traces.

tiers.4: A strong and outwardly present corruption may feel uncomfortable.
tiers.8: Distinguish that vague discomfort from everyday fear, subjectively.
tiers.12: Feel an obvious difference between ordinary unease and manifest spiritual heaviness.
tiers.16: A persistent, unmistakable disturbance may register as an oppressive pressure.
tiers.20: Recognize clearly manifest spiritual unease consistently, yet never determine its type, source, strength, or rules.

echoMemory: The air turns bitter. You remember a chapel where every candle went out at once, centuries before your birth.

name: Echo Whisper
tagline: Deliberately recall one brief emotional impression from a former life. It is a subjective experience; historical facts, hidden knowledge and trained techniques follow their normal rules.

tiers.4: Conjure a brief emotion or single sensory trace from another life.
tiers.8: Associate the feeling with a vague place or sound.
tiers.12: Experience one small subjective image from an unidentified past life.
tiers.16: See a short linked sequence of subjective past-life impressions.
tiers.20: In peace, experience a brief emotionally complete memory scene, without a guarantee of objective truth or secret knowledge.

echoMemory: You see the hands of someone you once loved. You carried a different name then, but immediately know their laugh.

name: Oath Ember
tagline: When you make a personal promise, a harmless symbolic light briefly marks your words. Binding Oath is the separate Ritual for a lasting, mutually witnessed agreement.

tiers.4: A faint spark accompanies a sincerely spoken promise.
tiers.8: The light briefly forms a personal emblem.
tiers.12: The symbol remains for a moment after the promise is spoken.
tiers.16: A little sign glows on your skin for several minutes.
tiers.20: A clear personal oath-light lasts through one calm scene; the oath gains no supernatural enforcement.

echoMemory: The sign flickers. You remember swearing fealty before a foreign crown, and the ache of knowing you broke that oath.

name: Glamour
tagline: Cast a cosmetic illusion over clothing, hair or superficial details. Successful impersonation still depends on the normal Social or Stealth rules.

tiers.4: Shift the perceived color of a minor item of clothing.
tiers.8: Briefly change fabric colors, hair highlights, or surface ornaments.
tiers.12: Give an entire outfit a slightly different appearance for a few minutes.
tiers.16: Portray a plausible costume or social style briefly, but not a specific person.
tiers.20: Maintain a coherent cosmetic appearance through a scene; a serious identity check still uses ordinary Skill Opposition.

echoMemory: The mirror fills with a glittering hall. The face inside belongs to someone else, and yet you recognize it as your own.

name: Mirror Shade
tagline: Manifest a fleeting, clearly unreal reflection or afterimage of yourself. It is a visible flourish rather than a second creature or a defensive combat effect.

tiers.4: See a displaced trace of your reflection for a heartbeat.
tiers.8: Show a second fleeting outline in glass or water.
tiers.12: An unmistakable afterimage follows one of your movements.
tiers.16: A silent spectral outline repeats a small gesture near you.
tiers.20: A fragile double copies part of your posture for several seconds; physical contact immediately reveals it is unreal.

echoMemory: Your reflection smiles a fraction too late. You recall an older face marked by scars in a bronze mirror.

name: Borrowed Voice
tagline: Alter the pitch, accent or apparent age of your voice. Using that change to impersonate someone is a Deception attempt when opposition matters.

tiers.4: Briefly make your voice deeper, brighter, or rougher.
tiers.8: Keep an unusual tone through several sentences.
tiers.12: Suggest a general age or vocal persona without copying a specific speaker.
tiers.16: Briefly evoke a recognizable remembered timbre, still imperfectly.
tiers.20: Maintain a detailed imitation through a short conversation; impersonation remains an ordinary Skill Opposition.

echoMemory: Your voice catches on one syllable. You remember a lullaby you once sang from another mouth.

name: Emotional Hue
tagline: Express your chosen mood through a faint aura of color, scent or soft light. Observers perceive this display according to their own feelings and judgment.

tiers.4: A subtle shimmer accompanies a mood you deliberately show.
tiers.8: Add a matching color or faint sensory note.
tiers.12: Create a short visible atmospheric pattern expressing your mood.
tiers.16: Let a gentle expressive aura accompany you for several calm minutes.
tiers.20: Sustain a beautiful but harmless personal atmosphere through one scene; listeners decide how they feel.

echoMemory: The air turns amber for a moment. You recall bidding farewell to a crowd without knowing who would return.

name: Ghost Sound
tagline: Produce a brief simple nonverbal sound nearby: a tap, scrape, bell note or rustle. If used to mislead a listener, resolve that deception normally.

tiers.4: Make one soft knock, click, or rustle within sight.
tiers.8: Place a short recognizable everyday sound slightly away from yourself.
tiers.12: Arrange two or three simple little sounds in a short sequence.
tiers.16: Reproduce one simple familiar sound pattern for a few seconds.
tiers.20: Make a brief harmless soundscape of several basic tones, but not human speech or complex music.

echoMemory: You hear footsteps no one has taken. An old staircase appears in your memory; every third step once creaked.

name: Waymark
tagline: Leave a temporary personal magical route mark on an inert surface; you and deliberately included companions can see it. Navigation and protected passages retain their normal rules.

tiers.4: One personal mark remains visible for roughly an hour.
tiers.8: Leave two or three signs along the same route back.
tiers.12: Mark a short path through a building you already know.
tiers.16: Mark one small local route through an evening.
tiers.20: Temporarily mark a connected route across a small area; Navigation and finding new routes remain Skills.

echoMemory: You place a sign on a stone. Suddenly you remember the same mark on trees in a forest you have never seen.

name: Second Glance
tagline: Recall a recently noticed moment as a subjective afterimage; advanced tiers let you share it with one willing witness. The recollection contains only impressions you actually perceived.

tiers.4: Replay one simple just-experienced impression inwardly for seconds.
tiers.8: Hold one subjective mental still image for a moment.
tiers.12: Share one fleeting subjective still image with a nearby consenting person.
tiers.16: Show yourself and one willing person a brief consciously seen motion.
tiers.20: Share several just-experienced seconds with one willing person as a fleeting subjective scene; it cannot prove objective facts.

echoMemory: A falling cup briefly seems to stop. You recall a silver vessel on another table and a hand that arrived too late.

name: Lucky Flicker
tagline: Prompt a harmless coincidence nearby: a brief candle flicker, a dancing leaf or a rattling button. The sign adds atmosphere while outcomes and dice remain unchanged.

tiers.4: A tiny irrelevant coincidence accompanies one moment.
tiers.8: Make a harmless little coincidence answer your chosen gesture.
tiers.12: Two harmless coincidences appear to line up for seconds.
tiers.16: A short sequence of beautiful or eerie micro-coincidences accompanies your story.
tiers.20: For a few minutes, trivial details seem strangely synchronized without changing any meaningful result or chance.

echoMemory: The candle flame leans toward your voice. You remember a long, dark corridor, a stranger holding a lamp, and an omen that once seemed terribly important.
